findings.description: Mary Dwyer's father was Patrick Dwyer, per a Massachusetts marriage record naming Mary Dwyer (b. 1832, Ireland) marrying Michael Dwyer (b. 1831, Ireland) on 21 April 1854 in Chicopee, Hampden, Massachusetts.
supporting_sources: Massachusetts, State Vital Records, 1638-1927 — marriage entry, 21 Apr 1854, Chicopee, Hampden, Massachusetts, for Michael Dwyer (son of John Dwyer) and Mary Dwyer (daughter of Patrick Dwyer)
